description: After the user reacts to a resolve_fragment result, call this with its resolution_id. accepted: it is what they meant. partial: it helped but is not quite it. rejected: it is not what they meant. If they recognised an item in the shortlist or leads, send picked_rank (1 = first item) or picked_url; if nothing fitted, send none_fitted: true. corrected_target and new_clue are optional and are stored as feedback only; they never change graph facts.

corrected_target.description: Optional. What the user was actually thinking of, if they know it. Max 300 characters.

new_clue.description: Optional. An extra detail the user remembered after seeing the result. Max 500 characters.

none_fitted.description: True if the user looked and nothing fitted.

note.description: Optional free-text note. Max 1000 characters. No personal data.

picked_rank.description: Position of the shortlist or lead item the user recognised.

picked_url.description: URL of the item the user recognised.

resolution_id.description: The resolution_id returned by the resolve_fragment call this feedback is about.

status.description: accepted: the result is what the user meant. partial: it helped but is not quite it. rejected: it is not what the user meant.

name: submit_resolution_feedback
title: Submit Resolution Feedback
